idea-plugin.name: Protostuff Tag Annotator
idea-plugin.description:
Adds and checks Protostuff @Tag annotations in Java and Kotlin classes. See protostuff-runtime.

  • Generate: Code | Generate (Alt+Insert, Cmd+N on macOS) → Generate Protostuff Tags. Pick the fields and see the numbers they will get before applying.
  • Single field: Alt+Enter on a field → Add @Tag(n), using the next number after the highest.
  • Inspection: warns about untagged fields in a tagged class, duplicate numbers (including inherited ones), numbers out of range, and tags Protostuff ignores, with quick fixes.
  • Many classes: right-click files, packages or folders in the Project view → Protostuff.
  • Renumber and Remove tags from Code | Protostuff or the Project view.

Adds import io.protostuff.Tag when it's missing. Numbers used in superclasses are never reused. Static and @Exclude fields are skipped; transient fields are optional.

Open source under the Apache License 2.0. Source: GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.2

  • Supports IntelliJ IDEA 2022.2 and later.

1.2.1

  • Plugin icon, and icons on the Protostuff menu actions.
  • Demo GIF in the plugin description.

1.2.0

  • Inspection for missing, duplicate, out-of-range and ignored tags, with quick fixes.
  • Alt+Enter intention to tag a single field.
  • Generate dialog lists the fields with their planned numbers; pick which ones to tag.
  • Generate, renumber and remove tags across files, packages and folders from the Project view.
  • Renumber and Remove actions.
  • Remembers the dialog choices.
  • Kotlin support (constructor properties and body properties with a backing field), writing @field:Tag so the tag lands on the field; warns about constructor tags without field:.
  • @Exclude fields are skipped.
  • Fixed: renumbering keeps the annotation's name and layout; "next free number" ignores out-of-range values.

Full history: CHANGELOG.md

1.1.1

  • Always writes @Tag and adds the import, even when Protostuff can't be resolved yet, instead of falling back to @io.protostuff.Tag.

1.1.0

  • Adds the io.protostuff.Tag import.
  • Running the action again no longer duplicates tags; existing tag numbers are kept and skipped.
  • The starting number is validated in the dialog.
  • Static fields are never tagged.
  • Supports IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 and later.

action.description: Renumber the @Tag annotations in declaration order
